cohort: Women with a singleton gestation and symptoms of threatened preterm labour (TPTL), presenting to a tertiary hospital between 24+0 to 33+6 weeks of gestation, who did not have vaginal bleeding, ruptured membranes, or cervical dilation > 3 cm.
finding: Quantitative fetal fibronectin (fFN) testing demonstrated predictive value for spontaneous preterm birth in symptomatic women, with high negative predictive values for ruling out delivery within 14 days and high positive predictive values for predicting delivery within 48 hours to 7 days, as well as before 37 weeks.
followup_time: Up to 37 weeks gestation (for PTB outcome)
gest_age: 24+0 to 33+6 weeks at recruitment; outcomes assessed for PTB < 37 weeks
